title: Partner Resistance Sprint
description: One partner provides light resistance with a hand on the back while the other drives forward, building explosive first-step power.

content.objective: Build explosive first-step power by driving forward against light partner resistance.
content.setup: Partners line up with the resisting partner's hand lightly on the other's back or shoulder.
instructions: The driving partner explodes forward for five steps against light resistance.
The resisting partner applies only enough resistance to challenge, not to stop the movement.
Switch roles after five reps each.
Finish with five reps of unresisted sprints to feel the speed transfer.
coachingPoints: Drive with the arms and a strong forward lean on the first few steps.
Resisting partner should apply light, steady pressure, not a sudden shove.
Finish each rep with a controlled deceleration, not a crash stop.
commonMistakes: Resisting partner applying too much force, risking a strain.
Driving partner leaning so far forward that balance is lost.
Letting technique break down once fatigue sets in.
content.safety: Keep the resistance light and controlled at all times; stop immediately if either partner loses balance.
